LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.rewriteLog.eq_def :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} (x : List (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.Template P)) (x_1 : LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitmentHistory P) (x_2 : List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P))), LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.rewriteLog x x_1 x_2 = match x, x_1, x_2 with | t :: ts, history, PoolGame.Event.transfer n1 n2 c1 c2 :: log => PoolGame.Event.transfer (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.referenceNf history t.input1 t.body.key n1) (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.referenceNf history t.input2 t.body.key n2) c1 c2 :: LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.rewriteLog ts (history ++ [(c1, c2)]) log | x, x_3, log => log

LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.rewriteObserver_simulate :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} (setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)) (ts : List (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.Template P)) (log : List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P))) (oa : OracleComp (PoolGame.observerSpec (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) Bool), simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (simulateQ (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.rewriteObserver setup ts) oa) = simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.observerView setup ++ LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.rewriteLog ts [] log)) oa
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.sampleWorld.eq_def :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (history : List (LeanShieldedPool.TransferData P)) (x : List (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.Template P)), LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.sampleWorld history x = match x with | [] => pure [] | t :: ts => do let s1 ← $ᵗ P.Salt let s2 ← $ᵗ P.Salt have d : LeanShieldedPool.TransferData P := LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.withSalts (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.resolve history t) s1 s2 let rest ← LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.sampleWorld (history ++ [d]) ts pure (d :: rest)

LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.sampleWorld_resolves :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (history : List (LeanShieldedPool.TransferData P)) (ts : List (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.Template P)), ∀ ds ∈ support (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.sampleWorld history ts), LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.Resolves history ts ds
# ChainGame.CommitOnly.Basic
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.Adversary.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} {State : Type} {choose : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × State)} {guess : State → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool} {State_1 : Type} {choose_1 : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × State_1)} {guess_1 : State_1 → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool}, { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 } → State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.Adversary.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} (State : Type) (choose : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × State)) (guess : State → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool) (State_1 : Type) (choose_1 : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × State_1)) (guess_1 : State_1 → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool), ({ State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 }) = (State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1)
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.Adversary.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} (State : Type) (choose : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.World P cap n × State)) (guess : State → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool), sizeOf { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = 1 + sizeOf State + sizeOf choose
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.atExperiment_eq_publish :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.Adversary P cap n) (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap), LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.atExperiment sup setup adv hp hn hc = do let __x ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc adv.choose match __x with | (l, r, s) => have left := LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.worldBack hp hn hc ↑l; have right := LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.worldBack hp hn hc ↑r; if LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.RecipientPair left right then do let b ← $ᵗ Bool let result ← LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.publish sup (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.rebaseTx hp hn hc) setup) (if b = true then right else left) match result with | none => $ᵗ Bool | some log => do let g ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc (adv.guess s (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.eventBack hp hn hc) log)) pure (b == g) else $ᵗ Bool
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.reduction_bound :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} (setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.Adversary P cap n) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (qc qg : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.QueryBound adv qc qg → LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.BatchQueryBound (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.reduction setup adv hn) (qc + 4 * setup.length + 4 * n) qg
LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.rejection_transport :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : SampleableType (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap)] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.Adversary P cap n), (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.experiment sup setup adv).boolDistAdvantage (LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.unguarded setup adv) ≤ LeanShieldedPool.ChainGame.CommitOnly.rejectionProbability sup setup adv / 2

LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.run_lower :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap : ℕ} {A : Type} (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap) (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) A), LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.runAttack hp hn (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.lower hc oa) = LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc oa
# CommitROM.Model
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.cm_bound :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (n : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.NotePlan P ι), (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.cm pk n).IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged 1
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.event_bound :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι) (i : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι), (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.event pk f i).IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged 4
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.history.eq_def :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι) (x : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.history pk f x = match x with | [] => pure [] | i :: is => do let e ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.event pk f i let es ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.history pk f is pure (e :: es)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.history_bound :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι) (is : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)), (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.history pk f is).IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged (4 * is.length)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.run_cm :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap) (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (n : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.NotePlan P ι), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.cm pk n) = pure (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.cm pk (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.rebaseNote hp hn hc n))
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.run_event :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap) (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι) (i : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.event pk f i) = pure (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.eventBack hp hn hc (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.event pk f (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.rebaseIntent hp hn hc i)))
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.run_history :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap) (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι) (is : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.history pk f is) = pure (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.eventBack hp hn hc) (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.event pk f) (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.rebaseIntent hp hn hc) is)))
# CommitROM.Pair
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary.mk.inj :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} {State : Type} {choose : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ((M × M) × (M × M) × State)} {guess : State → C → C → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool} {State_1 : Type} {choose_1 : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ((M × M) × (M × M) × State_1)} {guess_1 : State_1 → C → C → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool}, { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 } → State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary.mk.injEq :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} (State : Type) (choose : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ((M × M) × (M × M) × State)) (guess : State → C → C → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool) (State_1 : Type) (choose_1 : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ((M × M) × (M × M) × State_1)) (guess_1 : State_1 → C → C → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool), ({ State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 }) = (State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [inst : SizeOf M] [inst_1 : SizeOf S] [inst_2 : SizeOf C] [inst_3 : SizeOf I] [inst_4 : (a : I) → SizeOf (aux a)] (State : Type) (choose : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ((M × M) × (M × M) × State)) (guess : State → C → C → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool), sizeOf { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = 1 + sizeOf State + sizeOf choose
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairTest_bound :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [inst : SampleableType S] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary M S C aux) (qc qg : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairQueryBound adv qc qg → ∀ (f : M → C), (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairTest adv f).IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged (qc + (1 + qg))
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pair_advantage_le_queryBound :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [Finite M] [inst : Fintype S] [Finite C] [Nonempty C] [inst_3 : SampleableType S] [SampleableType C] [inst_5 : SampleableType (M × S → C)] [SampleableType (M → C)] (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary M S C aux) (qc qg : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairQueryBound adv qc qg → |Pr[= true | LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairExperiment other adv].toReal - 1 / 2| ≤ (2 * (↑qc + ↑qg) + 1) / ↑(Fintype.card S)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pair_ideal_eq_second :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [Finite M] [Fintype S] [Finite C] [Nonempty C] [inst : SampleableType S] [inst_1 : SampleableType C] [inst_2 : SampleableType (M × S → C)] [inst_3 : SampleableType (M → C)] (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary M S C aux), 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.ideal other (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairTest adv)] = 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.experiment other (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.secondReduction adv)]
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pair_real_eq :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [Finite M] [Fintype S] [Finite C] [Nonempty C] [inst : SampleableType S] [SampleableType C] [inst_2 : SampleableType (M × S → C)] [SampleableType (M → C)] (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary M S C aux), 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.real other (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairTest adv)] = 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairExperiment other adv]
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.secondReduction_bound :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [inst : SampleableType C] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairAdversary M S C aux) (qc qg : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.PairQueryBound adv qc qg → LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.QueryBound (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.secondReduction adv) qc qg
# CommitROM.Switch
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.programmed_eq_real :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [Finite M] [Fintype S] [Finite C] [Nonempty C] [inst : SampleableType S] [inst_1 : SampleableType (M × S → C)] [inst_2 : SampleableType (M → C)] (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (test : (M → C) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool), 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.programmed other test] = 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.real other test]
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.switch_bound :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [Finite M] [inst : Fintype S] [Finite C] [Nonempty C] [inst_3 : SampleableType S] [inst_4 : SampleableType (M × S → C)] [inst_5 : SampleableType (M → C)] (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (test : (M → C) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool) (q : ℕ), (∀ (f : M → C), (test f).IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged q) → (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.real other test).boolDistAdvantage (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.ideal other test) ≤ ↑q / ↑(Fintype.card S)
# CommitROM.TableCollision
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairCount.eq_def :: ∀ (x : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairCount x = match x with | 0 => 0 | n.succ => n + LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairCount n
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairCount_twice :: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 * LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairCount n = n * (n - 1)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.table_collision_le :: ∀ {I C : Type} [Finite I] [inst : Fintype C] [Nonempty C] [SampleableType C] [inst_3 : SampleableType (I → C)] (xs : List I), xs.Nodup → (probEvent ($ᵗ (I → C)) fun hc => ¬(List.map hc xs).Nodup) ≤ ↑(LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.pairCount xs.length) / ↑(Fintype.card C)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.table_collision_le_real :: ∀ {I C : Type} [Finite I] [inst : Fintype C] [Nonempty C] [SampleableType C] [inst_3 : SampleableType (I → C)] (xs : List I), xs.Nodup → (probEvent ($ᵗ (I → C)) fun hc => ¬(List.map hc xs).Nodup).toReal ≤ ↑xs.length * (↑xs.length - 1) / (2 * ↑(Fintype.card C))
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.table_hit_list_le :: ∀ {I C : Type} [Finite I] [inst : Fintype C] [Nonempty C] [SampleableType C] [inst_3 : SampleableType (I → C)] (i : I) (xs : List I), i ∉ xs → (probEvent ($ᵗ (I → C)) fun hc => hc i ∈ List.map hc xs) ≤ ↑xs.length / ↑(Fintype.card C)
# CommitROM.Trace
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.distance_le_trace_hit :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} (bad : Set S) (so so' : QueryImpl (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ProbComp), (∀ (t : (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux).Domain), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.querySalts t) → so t = so' t) → ∀ (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool), (simulateQ so oa).boolDistAdvantage (simulateQ so' oa) ≤ (probEvent (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so oa) fun z => ¬LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad z.2).toReal
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.independent_trace_hit :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : SampleableType S] {α : Type} (so : QueryImpl (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ProbComp) (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) α) (q : ℕ), oa.IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged q → (probEvent (do let z ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so oa let s ← $ᵗ S pure (z, s)) fun z => z.2 ∈ z.1.2) ≤ ↑q / ↑(Fintype.card S)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.program_answers_agree :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (h : M × S → C) (f : M → C) (s : S) (t : (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux).Domain), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid {s} (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.querySalts t) → OracleComp.unifFwdAnswerImpl (QueryImpl.ofFn h + other) t = OracleComp.unifFwdAnswerImpl (QueryImpl.ofFn (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.program (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.saltCoord s) h f) + other) t
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.programming_bound :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : SampleableType S] (other : QueryImpl aux Id) (h : M × S → C) (f : M → C) (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) Bool) (q : ℕ), oa.IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged q → ((do let _ ← $ᵗ S LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run other h oa).boolDistAdvantage do let s ← $ᵗ S LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run other (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.program (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.saltCoord s) h f) oa) ≤ ↑q / ↑(Fintype.card S)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.saltCoord_injective :: ∀ {M S : Type} (s : S), Function.Injective (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.saltCoord s)
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace_bad_eq :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} {α : Type} (bad : Set S) (so so' : QueryImpl (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ProbComp), (∀ (t : (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux).Domain), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.querySalts t) → so t = so' t) → ∀ (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) α), (probEvent (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so oa) fun z => ¬LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad z.2) = probEvent (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so' oa) fun z => ¬LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad z.2
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace_eq_good :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} {α : Type} (bad : Set S) (so so' : QueryImpl (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ProbComp), (∀ (t : (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux).Domain), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.querySalts t) → so t = so' t) → ∀ (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) α) (z : α × List S), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Avoid bad z.2 → Pr[= z | LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so oa] = Pr[= z | LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so' oa]
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace_length_bound :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} {α : Type} (so : QueryImpl (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ProbComp) (oa : OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) α) (q : ℕ), oa.IsQueryBoundP LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.charged q → ∀ z ∈ support (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so oa), z.2.length ≤ q
LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace_query_bind :: ∀ {M S C I : Type} {aux : OracleSpec I} {α : Type} (so : QueryImpl (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) ProbComp) (t : (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux).Domain) (k : (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux).Range t → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.attackSpec M S C aux) α), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so (liftM (OracleSpec.query t) >>= k) = do let u ← so t let z ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.trace so (k u) pure (z.1, LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.querySalts t ++ z.2)

LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.realizesWorld_realizesLog :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {sup : P.Token → Prop} {ws : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P))} {log : List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P))}, LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.RealizesWorld sup ws log → LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.RealizesLog sup log
LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.run_events_guard :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {sup : P.Token → Prop} {txs : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)} {st : LeanShieldedPool.St P}, LeanShieldedPool.Run sup txs st → ∀ e ∈ LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.observerView txs, LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.EventGuard e
LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.run_observer_correspondence :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {sup : P.Token → Prop} {txs : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)} {st : LeanShieldedPool.St P} (run : LeanShieldedPool.Run sup txs st), LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.runObserverView run = List.map LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gameEvent (LeanShieldedPool.events txs)
LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.singleton_in_publish_support :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (w : PoolGame.TransferWitness (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) (s1 s2 : P.Salt), [w.toEvent s1 s2] ∈ support (PoolGame.publish [w])

PoolGame.publish.eq_def :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (x : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)), PoolGame.publish x = match x with | [] => pure [] | w :: ws => do let s1 ← $ᵗ P.Salt let s2 ← $ᵗ P.Salt let rest ← PoolGame.publish ws pure (w.toEvent s1 s2 :: rest)
# OwnerGame.Basic
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι State : Type} {choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge P ι × State)} {guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool} {State_1 : Type} {choose_1 : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge P ι × State_1)} {guess_1 : State_1 → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool}, { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 } → State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (State : Type) (choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge P ι × State)) (guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool) (State_1 : Type) (choose_1 : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge P ι × State_1)) (guess_1 : State_1 → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool), ({ State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 }) = (State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1)
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SizeOf ι] (State : Type) (choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge P ι × State)) (guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool), sizeOf { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = 1 + sizeOf State
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {prior : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)} {token : P.Token} {amount : ℕ} {funding : P.Address} {left right : ι} {prior_1 : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)} {token_1 : P.Token} {amount_1 : ℕ} {funding_1 : P.Address} {left_1 right_1 : ι}, { prior := prior, token := token, amount := amount, funding := funding, left := left, right := right } = { prior := prior_1, token := token_1, amount := amount_1, funding := funding_1, left := left_1, right := right_1 } → prior = prior_1 ∧ token = token_1 ∧ amount = amount_1 ∧ funding = funding_1 ∧ left = left_1 ∧ right = right_1
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (prior : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)) (token : P.Token) (amount : ℕ) (funding : P.Address) (left right : ι) (prior_1 : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)) (token_1 : P.Token) (amount_1 : ℕ) (funding_1 : P.Address) (left_1 right_1 : ι), ({ prior := prior, token := token, amount := amount, funding := funding, left := left, right := right } = { prior := prior_1, token := token_1, amount := amount_1, funding := funding_1, left := left_1, right := right_1 }) = (prior = prior_1 ∧ token = token_1 ∧ amount = amount_1 ∧ funding = funding_1 ∧ left = left_1 ∧ right = right_1)
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SizeOf ι] (prior : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)) (token : P.Token) (amount : ℕ) (funding : P.Address) (left right : ι), sizeOf { prior := prior, token := token, amount := amount, funding := funding, left := left, right := right } = 1 + sizeOf prior + sizeOf token + sizeOf amount + sizeOf funding + sizeOf left + sizeOf right
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.advantage_le :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] [inst_1 : SampleableType P.Salt] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary P ι) (ε : ℝ), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Hiding ε → LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.advantage sup adv ≤ ε / 2 + LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.rejectionProbability sup adv / 2
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.branch_distance :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary P ι) (keys : ι → P.SpendKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Challenge P ι) (s : adv.State) (ε : ℝ), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Hiding ε → (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.branch adv keys c s true).boolDistAdvantage (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.branch adv keys c s false) ≤ ε

LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.rejection_transport :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] [inst_1 : SampleableType P.Salt] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary P ι), (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.experiment sup adv).boolDistAdvantage (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.unguarded adv) ≤ LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.rejectionProbability sup adv / 2
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.unguarded_bias_le :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] [inst_1 : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary P ι) (ε : ℝ), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Hiding ε → |Pr[= true | LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.unguarded adv].toReal - 1 / 2| ≤ ε / 2

LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Adversary.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (State : Type) (choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Challenge P ι cap × State)) (guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool) (State_1 : Type) (choose_1 : (ι → P.PubKey) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Challenge P ι cap × State_1)) (guess_1 : State_1 → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool), ({ State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 }) = (State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1)
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Adversary.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} [inst : SizeOf ι] (State : Type) (choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Challenge P ι cap × State)) (guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → OracleComp (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Spec P cap) Bool), sizeOf { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = 1 + sizeOf State
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.reduction_bound :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Adversary P ι cap) (qc qg L : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.QueryBound adv qc qg → LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.HistoryBound adv L → ∀ (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι), LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.QueryBound (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.reduction adv pk f) (qc + 4 * L) qg
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.reduction_eq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : SampleableType (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap)] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Adversary P ι cap) (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (keys : ι → P.SpendKey), 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.experiment (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.reduction adv (hp ∘ keys) fun x => hn (keys x.1, x.2))] = 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.atUnguarded adv hp hn keys]
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.response_view :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {cap : ℕ} (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Adversary P ι cap) (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap) (keys : ι → P.SpendKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.Challenge P ι cap) (s : adv.State) (salt : P.Salt) (b : Bool), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.response (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.gameAdversary adv hp hn hc) keys (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.ROMCommit.rebaseChallenge hp hn hc ↑c) s salt b = do let g ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc (adv.guess s (hp ∘ keys) (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.eventBack hp hn hc) (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.event (hp ∘ keys) fun x => hn (keys x.1, x.2)) (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.rebaseIntent hp hn hc) (↑c).prior)) ++ [PoolGame.Event.deposit (hc (((↑c).token, ⟨(↑c).amount, c.property⟩, hp (keys (if b = true then (↑c).right else (↑c).left))), salt))])) pure (b == g)

PoolGame.PrimSpec.mk.injEq :: ∀ (Token Address PubKey SpendKey Salt Commitment Nullifier : Type) (derivePub : SpendKey → PubKey) (commit : Token → ℕ → PubKey → Salt → Commitment) (nullify : Commitment → SpendKey → Nullifier) (Token_1 Address_1 PubKey_1 SpendKey_1 Salt_1 Commitment_1 Nullifier_1 : Type) (derivePub_1 : SpendKey_1 → PubKey_1) (commit_1 : Token_1 → ℕ → PubKey_1 → Salt_1 → Commitment_1) (nullify_1 : Commitment_1 → SpendKey_1 → Nullifier_1), ({ Token := Token, Address := Address, PubKey := PubKey, SpendKey := SpendKey, Salt := Salt, Commitment := Commitment, Nullifier := Nullifier, derivePub := derivePub, commit := commit, nullify := nullify } = { Token := Token_1, Address := Address_1, PubKey := PubKey_1, SpendKey := SpendKey_1, Salt := Salt_1, Commitment := Commitment_1, Nullifier := Nullifier_1, derivePub := derivePub_1, commit := commit_1, nullify := nullify_1 }) = (Token = Token_1 ∧ Address = Address_1 ∧ PubKey = PubKey_1 ∧ SpendKey = SpendKey_1 ∧ Salt = Salt_1 ∧ Commitment = Commitment_1 ∧ Nullifier = Nullifier_1 ∧ derivePub ≍ derivePub_1 ∧ commit ≍ commit_1 ∧ nullify ≍ nullify_1)
PoolGame.PrimSpec.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ (Token Address PubKey SpendKey Salt Commitment Nullifier : Type) (derivePub : SpendKey → PubKey) (commit : Token → ℕ → PubKey → Salt → Commitment) (nullify : Commitment → SpendKey → Nullifier), sizeOf { Token := Token, Address := Address, PubKey := PubKey, SpendKey := SpendKey, Salt := Salt, Commitment := Commitment, Nullifier := Nullifier, derivePub := derivePub, commit := commit, nullify := nullify } = 1 + sizeOf Token + sizeOf Address + sizeOf PubKey + sizeOf SpendKey + sizeOf Salt + sizeOf Commitment + sizeOf Nullifier
PoolGame.TransferIndAdv.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} {State : Type} {chooseWorlds : ProbComp (List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × State)} {distinguish : State → OracleComp (PoolGame.observerSpec P) Bool} {State_1 : Type} {chooseWorlds_1 : ProbComp (List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × State_1)} {distinguish_1 : State_1 → OracleComp (PoolGame.observerSpec P) Bool}, { State := State, chooseWorlds := chooseWorlds, distinguish := distinguish } = { State := State_1, chooseWorlds := chooseWorlds_1, distinguish := distinguish_1 } → State = State_1 ∧ chooseWorlds ≍ chooseWorlds_1 ∧ distinguish ≍ distinguish_1
PoolGame.TransferIndAdv.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} (State : Type) (chooseWorlds : ProbComp (List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × State)) (distinguish : State → OracleComp (PoolGame.observerSpec P) Bool) (State_1 : Type) (chooseWorlds_1 : ProbComp (List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × State_1)) (distinguish_1 : State_1 → OracleComp (PoolGame.observerSpec P) Bool), ({ State := State, chooseWorlds := chooseWorlds, distinguish := distinguish } = { State := State_1, chooseWorlds := chooseWorlds_1, distinguish := distinguish_1 }) = (State = State_1 ∧ chooseWorlds ≍ chooseWorlds_1 ∧ distinguish ≍ distinguish_1)
PoolGame.TransferIndAdv.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} (State : Type) (chooseWorlds : ProbComp (List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P) × State)) (distinguish : State → OracleComp (PoolGame.observerSpec P) Bool), sizeOf { State := State, chooseWorlds := chooseWorlds, distinguish := distinguish } = 1 + sizeOf State + sizeOf chooseWorlds
PoolGame.TransferWitness.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} {inCm1 inCm2 : P.Commitment} {spendKey1 spendKey2 : P.SpendKey} {outToken1 : P.Token} {outAmt1 : ℕ} {outPk1 : P.PubKey} {outToken2 : P.Token} {outAmt2 : ℕ} {outPk2 : P.PubKey} {inCm1_1 inCm2_1 : P.Commitment} {spendKey1_1 spendKey2_1 : P.SpendKey} {outToken1_1 : P.Token} {outAmt1_1 : ℕ} {outPk1_1 : P.PubKey} {outToken2_1 : P.Token} {outAmt2_1 : ℕ} {outPk2_1 : P.PubKey}, { inCm1 := inCm1, inCm2 := inCm2, spendKey1 := spendKey1, spendKey2 := spendKey2, outToken1 := outToken1, outAmt1 := outAmt1, outPk1 := outPk1, outToken2 := outToken2, outAmt2 := outAmt2, outPk2 := outPk2 } = { inCm1 := inCm1_1, inCm2 := inCm2_1, spendKey1 := spendKey1_1, spendKey2 := spendKey2_1, outToken1 := outToken1_1, outAmt1 := outAmt1_1, outPk1 := outPk1_1, outToken2 := outToken2_1, outAmt2 := outAmt2_1, outPk2 := outPk2_1 } → inCm1 = inCm1_1 ∧ inCm2 = inCm2_1 ∧ spendKey1 = spendKey1_1 ∧ spendKey2 = spendKey2_1 ∧ outToken1 = outToken1_1 ∧ outAmt1 = outAmt1_1 ∧ outPk1 = outPk1_1 ∧ outToken2 = outToken2_1 ∧ outAmt2 = outAmt2_1 ∧ outPk2 = outPk2_1
PoolGame.TransferWitness.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} (inCm1 inCm2 : P.Commitment) (spendKey1 spendKey2 : P.SpendKey) (outToken1 : P.Token) (outAmt1 : ℕ) (outPk1 : P.PubKey) (outToken2 : P.Token) (outAmt2 : ℕ) (outPk2 : P.PubKey) (inCm1_1 inCm2_1 : P.Commitment) (spendKey1_1 spendKey2_1 : P.SpendKey) (outToken1_1 : P.Token) (outAmt1_1 : ℕ) (outPk1_1 : P.PubKey) (outToken2_1 : P.Token) (outAmt2_1 : ℕ) (outPk2_1 : P.PubKey), ({ inCm1 := inCm1, inCm2 := inCm2, spendKey1 := spendKey1, spendKey2 := spendKey2, outToken1 := outToken1, outAmt1 := outAmt1, outPk1 := outPk1, outToken2 := outToken2, outAmt2 := outAmt2, outPk2 := outPk2 } = { inCm1 := inCm1_1, inCm2 := inCm2_1, spendKey1 := spendKey1_1, spendKey2 := spendKey2_1, outToken1 := outToken1_1, outAmt1 := outAmt1_1, outPk1 := outPk1_1, outToken2 := outToken2_1, outAmt2 := outAmt2_1, outPk2 := outPk2_1 }) = (inCm1 = inCm1_1 ∧ inCm2 = inCm2_1 ∧ spendKey1 = spendKey1_1 ∧ spendKey2 = spendKey2_1 ∧ outToken1 = outToken1_1 ∧ outAmt1 = outAmt1_1 ∧ outPk1 = outPk1_1 ∧ outToken2 = outToken2_1 ∧ outAmt2 = outAmt2_1 ∧ outPk2 = outPk2_1)
PoolGame.TransferWitness.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} (inCm1 inCm2 : P.Commitment) (spendKey1 spendKey2 : P.SpendKey) (outToken1 : P.Token) (outAmt1 : ℕ) (outPk1 : P.PubKey) (outToken2 : P.Token) (outAmt2 : ℕ) (outPk2 : P.PubKey), sizeOf { inCm1 := inCm1, inCm2 := inCm2, spendKey1 := spendKey1, spendKey2 := spendKey2, outToken1 := outToken1, outAmt1 := outAmt1, outPk1 := outPk1, outToken2 := outToken2, outAmt2 := outAmt2, outPk2 := outPk2 } = 1 + sizeOf inCm1 + sizeOf inCm2 + sizeOf spendKey1 + sizeOf spendKey2 + sizeOf outToken1 + sizeOf outAmt1 + sizeOf outPk1 + sizeOf outToken2 + sizeOf outAmt2 + sizeOf outPk2
PoolGame.boolDistAdvantage_le_sum_range :: ∀ {n : ℕ} (games : ℕ → ProbComp Bool), (games 0).boolDistAdvantage (games n) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (games i).boolDistAdvantage (games (i + 1))
PoolGame.hybridExp_last :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), ws₀.length = ws₁.length → PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st ws₀.length = do let log ← PoolGame.publish ws₁ simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)
PoolGame.hybridExp_zero :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st 0 = do let log ← PoolGame.publish ws₀ simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)
PoolGame.hybridWorld_length :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)), ws₀.length = ws₁.length → PoolGame.hybridWorld ws₀ ws₁ ws₀.length = ws₁
PoolGame.hybridWorld_zero :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)), PoolGame.hybridWorld ws₀ ws₁ 0 = ws₀
PoolGame.hybrid_bound :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), PoolGame.LegalChallenge ws₀ ws₁ → ((do let log ← PoolGame.publish ws₀ simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)).boolDistAdvantage do let log ← PoolGame.publish ws₁ simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ws₀.length, (PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st i).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st (i + 1))
PoolGame.lengths_match_of_legalChallenge :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} {ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)}, PoolGame.LegalChallenge ws₀ ws₁ → ws₀.length = ws₁.length
PoolGame.transferChallengeExp_of_illegal :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), ¬PoolGame.LegalChallenge ws₀ ws₁ → PoolGame.transferChallengeExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st = $ᵗ Bool
PoolGame.transferChallengeExp_of_legal :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), PoolGame.LegalChallenge ws₀ ws₁ → PoolGame.transferChallengeExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st = do let b ← $ᵗ Bool let log ← PoolGame.publish (if b = true then ws₁ else ws₀) let b' ← simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st) pure (b == b')
PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage_nil_singleton :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (w : PoolGame.TransferWitness P) (st : adv.State), adv.chooseWorlds = pure ([], [w], st) → PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage adv = 0
PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage_nonneg :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P), 0 ≤ PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage adv
PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage_of_illegal_pure :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), adv.chooseWorlds = pure (ws₀, ws₁, st) → ¬PoolGame.LegalChallenge ws₀ ws₁ → PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage adv = 0
PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage_of_length_ne :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), adv.chooseWorlds = pure (ws₀, ws₁, st) → ws₀.length ≠ ws₁.length → PoolGame.transferIndAdvantage adv = 0
# PoolGame.Summand
PoolGame.Summand.commitment_distance_eq :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (m₀ m₁ : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.commitBranch pref m₀ observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.commitBranch pref m₁ observe) = 2 * A.cs.hidingAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.hidingReduction pref m₀ m₁ observe)
PoolGame.Summand.commitment_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (m₀ m₁ : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.commitBranch pref m₀ observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.commitBranch pref m₁ observe) ≤ 2 * A.εHiding
PoolGame.Summand.first_output_distance_eq :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (m₀ m₁ other : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref m₀ other observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref m₁ other observe) = 2 * A.cs.hidingAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.firstOutputReduction pref m₀ m₁ other observe)
PoolGame.Summand.first_output_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (m₀ m₁ other : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref m₀ other observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref m₁ other observe) ≤ 2 * A.εHiding
PoolGame.Summand.hybrid_step_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State) (i : ℕ) (h₀ : i < ws₀.length) (h₁ : i < ws₁.length), PoolGame.RecipientOnly ws₀[i] ws₁[i] → (PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st i).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st (i + 1)) ≤ 4 * A.εHiding
PoolGame.Summand.legal_hybrid_step_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (ws₀ ws₁ : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (st : adv.State), PoolGame.LegalChallenge ws₀ ws₁ → ∀ i < ws₀.length, (PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st i).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.hybridExp adv ws₀ ws₁ st (i + 1)) ≤ 4 * A.εHiding
PoolGame.Summand.publish_append :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (pre post : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)), PoolGame.publish (pre ++ post) = do let l ← PoolGame.publish pre let r ← PoolGame.publish post pure (l ++ r)
PoolGame.Summand.publish_transfer :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (st : adv.State) (pre post : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (w : PoolGame.TransferWitness P), (do let log ← PoolGame.publish (pre ++ w :: post) simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)) = PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp (PoolGame.publish pre) (PoolGame.Summand.outputMessage₁ w) (PoolGame.Summand.outputMessage₂ w) (PoolGame.Summand.observeTransfer adv st post (P.nullify w.inCm1 w.spendKey1) (P.nullify w.inCm2 w.spendKey2))
PoolGame.Summand.second_output_distance_eq :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (other m₀ m₁ : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref other m₀ observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref other m₁ observe) = 2 * A.cs.hidingAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.secondOutputReduction pref other m₀ m₁ observe)
PoolGame.Summand.second_output_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (other m₀ m₁ : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref other m₀ observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref other m₁ observe) ≤ 2 * A.εHiding
PoolGame.Summand.transfer_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (adv : PoolGame.TransferIndAdv P) (st : adv.State) (pre post : List (PoolGame.TransferWitness P)) (w₀ w₁ : PoolGame.TransferWitness P), PoolGame.RecipientOnly w₀ w₁ → ((do let log ← PoolGame.publish (pre ++ w₀ :: post) simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)).boolDistAdvantage do let log ← PoolGame.publish (pre ++ w₁ :: post) simulateQ (PoolGame.observerImpl log) (adv.distinguish st)) ≤ 4 * A.εHiding
PoolGame.Summand.two_output_distance_le :: ∀ {P : PoolGame.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] {α : Type} (A : PoolGame.PoolAssumptions P) (pref : ProbComp α) (m₁₀ m₁₁ m₂₀ m₂₁ : P.Token × ℕ × P.PubKey) (observe : α → P.Commitment → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref m₁₀ m₂₀ observe).boolDistAdvantage (PoolGame.Summand.twoCommitExp pref m₁₁ m₂₁ observe) ≤ 4 * A.εHiding
# PrivacyTools.Basic
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.coin_bias :: ∀ (f : Bool → ProbComp Bool), |Pr[= true | LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.coin f].toReal - 1 / 2| = (f true).boolDistAdvantage (f false) / 2
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.distance_fair :: ∀ (p : ProbComp Bool), p.boolDistAdvantage ($ᵗ Bool) = |Pr[= true | p].toReal - 1 / 2|
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.hiding_pair :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (ε : ℝ), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Hiding ε → ∀ (t₁ t₂ t₁' t₂' : P.Token) (a₁ a₂ a₁' a₂' : ℕ) (pk₁ pk₂ pk₁' pk₂' : P.PubKey) (test : P.Commitment → P.Commitment → ProbComp Bool), ((do let s₁ ← $ᵗ P.Salt let s₂ ← $ᵗ P.Salt test (P.commit t₁ a₁ pk₁ s₁) (P.commit t₂ a₂ pk₂ s₂)).boolDistAdvantage do let s₁ ← $ᵗ P.Salt let s₂ ← $ᵗ P.Salt test (P.commit t₁' a₁' pk₁' s₁) (P.commit t₂' a₂' pk₂' s₂)) ≤ 2 * ε
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.independent_and :: ∀ {α β : Type} (d : ProbComp α) (e : ProbComp β) (p : α → Prop) (q : β → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred p] [inst_1 : DecidablePred q], Pr[= true | do let a ← d let b ← e pure (decide (p a ∧ q b))] = probEvent d p * probEvent e q
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.pure_or_fair_probability :: ∀ {α : Type} (d : ProbComp α) (p : α → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred p], Pr[= true | do let a ← d if p a then pure true else $ᵗ Bool].toReal = 1 / 2 + (probEvent d p).toReal / 2
# PrivacyTools.Rejection
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.advantage_le_explicit :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] [inst_1 : SampleableType P.Salt] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary P ι) (ε : ℝ), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Hiding ε → LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.advantage sup adv ≤ ε / 2 + ((LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.terms sup adv).1 + (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.terms sup adv).2.1 + (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.terms sup adv).2.2) / 2
LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.rejection_partition :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] [inst_1 : SampleableType P.Salt] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Adversary P ι), LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.rejectionProbability sup adv = (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.terms sup adv).1 + (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.terms sup adv).2.1 + (LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.terms sup adv).2.2
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.decide_probability :: ∀ {α : Type} (d : ProbComp α) (p : α → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred p], Pr[= true | do let a ← d pure (decide (p a))] = probEvent d p
LeanShieldedPool.PrivacyTools.partition_four :: ∀ {α : Type} (d : ProbComp α) (bad p q r : α → Prop), (probEvent d bad).toReal = (probEvent d fun a => bad a ∧ p a).toReal + (probEvent d fun a => bad a ∧ ¬p a ∧ q a).toReal + (probEvent d fun a => bad a ∧ ¬p a ∧ ¬q a ∧ r a).toReal + (probEvent d fun a => bad a ∧ ¬p a ∧ ¬q a ∧ ¬r a).toReal
LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.advantage_le_explicit :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [Finite P.Commitment] [Finite P.Nullifier] [Nonempty P.Nullifier] [SampleableType P.Nullifier] [inst_5 : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_6 : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] [inst_7 : SampleableType (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι)] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Adversary P ι) (εPRF εHide : ℝ), LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.MultiKeyPublicKeyPRF (↑(Fintype.card ι) * εPRF) → 0 ≤ εHide → LeanShieldedPool.OwnerGame.Hiding εHide → LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.advantage sup adv ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι) * εPRF + εHide + ((LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.terms sup adv).1 + (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.terms sup adv).2.1 + (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.terms sup adv).2.2.1 + (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.terms sup adv).2.2.2) / 2

LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.atExperiment_eq_publish2 :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {cap n : ℕ} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.Adversary P cap n) (hp : P.SpendKey → P.PubKey) (hn : P.SpendKey × P.Commitment → P.Nullifier) (hc : LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.Table P cap), LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.atExperiment sup setup adv hp hn hc = do let __x ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc adv.choose match __x with | (l, r, s) => have left := LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.worldBack hp hn hc ↑l; have right := LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.worldBack hp hn hc ↑r; if LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.RecipientPair left right then do let b ← $ᵗ Bool let result ← LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.publish2 sup (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.ROMCommit.rebaseTx hp hn hc) setup) (if b = true then right else left) match result with | none => $ᵗ Bool | some log => do let g ← LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.run (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.ROM.answers hp hn) hc (adv.guess s (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.CommitROM.Model.eventBack hp hn hc) log)) pure (b == g) else $ᵗ Bool

LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.WellFormedAdversary.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {sup : P.Token → Prop} {setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)} {adv : LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Adversary P} {m : ℕ} (initial : LeanShieldedPool.St P) (setup_run : LeanShieldedPool.Run sup setup initial) (leaf_bound : initial.minted.length ≤ m) (worlds : ∀ a ∈ support adv.chooseWorlds, LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.WellFormed initial a.1 ∧ LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.WellFormed initial a.2.1) (initial_1 : LeanShieldedPool.St P) (setup_run_1 : LeanShieldedPool.Run sup setup initial_1) (leaf_bound_1 : initial_1.minted.length ≤ m) (worlds_1 : ∀ a ∈ support adv.chooseWorlds, LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.WellFormed initial_1 a.1 ∧ LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.WellFormed initial_1 a.2.1), ({ initial := initial, setup_run := setup_run, leaf_bound := leaf_bound, worlds := worlds } = { initial := initial_1, setup_run := setup_run_1, leaf_bound := leaf_bound_1, worlds := worlds_1 }) = (initial = initial_1)

LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.advantage_le :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} [inst : SampleableType P.Salt] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P.Commitment] [inst_2 : SampleableType P.Nullifier] (q : ℕ), LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.CommitmentSpread q → ∀ (sup : P.Token → Prop) (setup : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Adversary P) (m n : ℕ) (W : LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.WellFormedAdversary sup setup adv m) (H : LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.BoundAssumptions adv n), LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.advantage sup setup adv ≤ 2 * ↑n * H.primitives.εHiding + LeanShieldedPool.RecipientGame.Rejection.delta m n q / 2

LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Adversary.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι State : Type} {choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Challenge P ι × State)} {guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool} {State_1 : Type} {choose_1 : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Challenge P ι × State_1)} {guess_1 : State_1 → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool}, { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 } → State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1

LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Adversary.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SizeOf ι] (State : Type) (choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Challenge P ι × State)) (guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool), sizeOf { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = 1 + sizeOf State
LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Challenge.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} {prior : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)} {left right : LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.World P ι} {snapshot : ℕ} {prior_1 : List (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι)} {left_1 right_1 : LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.World P ι} {snapshot_1 : ℕ}, { prior := prior, left := left, right := right, snapshot := snapshot } = { prior := prior_1, left := left_1, right := right_1, snapshot := snapshot_1 } → prior = prior_1 ∧ left = left_1 ∧ right = right_1 ∧ snapshot = snapshot_1

LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Output.mk.injEq :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (token : P.Token) (amount : ℕ) (owner : ι) (token_1 : P.Token) (amount_1 : ℕ) (owner_1 : ι), ({ token := token, amount := amount, owner := owner } = { token := token_1, amount := amount_1, owner := owner_1 }) = (token = token_1 ∧ amount = amount_1 ∧ owner = owner_1)

LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.leaked_round :: ∀ (keys : LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.Keys) (s₁ s₂ : Fin 5), Pr[= true | do let b ← $ᵗ Bool LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.challengeExp (fun x => True) (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.adversary fun x log => pure (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.leakedGuess (keys ()) log)) keys LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.challenge () s₁ s₂ b] = if LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.Distinct keys ∧ LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.OutputsOK s₁ s₂ then 1 else 1 / 2

LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.swap_view :: ∀ (keys : LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.Keys) (s₁ s₂ : Fin 5), LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.observerView (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.challenge.history (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.swapKeys keys) s₁ s₂ false) = LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.observerView (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.challenge.history keys s₁ s₂ true)

LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.toy_with_one_key_bias :: |Pr[= true | LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.leakedExperiment].toReal - 1 / 2| = 9 / 200
LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.toy_without_key_zero :: ∀ (g : (Unit → Bool) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.Prim)) → ProbComp Bool), LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.advantage (fun x => True) (LeanShieldedPool.SenderGame.Toy.adversary g) = 0

LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary.mk.inj :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι State : Type} {choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι × State)} {guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool} {State_1 : Type} {choose_1 : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι × State_1)} {guess_1 : State_1 → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool}, { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = { State := State_1, choose := choose_1, guess := guess_1 } → State = State_1 ∧ choose ≍ choose_1 ∧ guess ≍ guess_1

LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary.mk.sizeOf_spec :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SizeOf ι] (State : Type) (choose : (ι → P.PubKey) → ProbComp (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι × State)) (guess : State → (ι → P.PubKey) → List (PoolGame.Event (LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.gamePrim P)) → ProbComp Bool), sizeOf { State := State, choose := choose, guess := guess } = 1 + sizeOf State

LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.challenge_eq_reject_response :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary P ι) (keys : ι → P.SpendKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι) (s : adv.State) (b : Bool), LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.challengeExp sup adv keys c s b = if LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.rejected sup keys c b = true then $ᵗ Bool else LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.response adv (P.derivePub ∘ keys) (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.realTable keys) c s b

LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.fair_coin_guess :: ∀ (g : ProbComp Bool), 𝒮[do let b ← $ᵗ Bool let z ← g pure (b == z)] = 𝒮[$ᵗ Bool]
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.fresh_guess_uniform :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] [Finite P.Commitment] [Finite P.Nullifier] [Nonempty P.Nullifier] [inst : SampleableType P.Nullifier] [inst_1 : SampleableType (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι)] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary P ι) (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι) (s : adv.State) (b : Bool), LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Fresh pk c → 𝒮[do let f ← $ᵗ LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι adv.guess s pk (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.view pk f c b)] = 𝒮[do let u ← $ᵗ P.Nullifier let f ← $ᵗ LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι adv.guess s pk (List.map (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.event pk f) c.prior ++ [PoolGame.Event.withdraw u])]
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.ideal_response_fair :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] [Finite P.Commitment] [Finite P.Nullifier] [Nonempty P.Nullifier] [SampleableType P.Nullifier] [inst : SampleableType (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι)] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary P ι) (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι) (s : adv.State), 𝒮[do let f ← $ᵗ LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι let b ← $ᵗ Bool LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.response adv pk f c s b] = 𝒮[$ᵗ Bool]

LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.prior_update :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : DecidableEq (ι × P.Commitment)] (pk : ι → P.PubKey) (f : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.Table P ι) (x : ι × P.Commitment) (u : P.Nullifier) (c : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι), x ∉ List.flatMap (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.queries pk) c.prior → List.map (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.event pk (Function.update f x u)) c.prior = List.map (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.event pk f) c.prior
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.queries_real :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (keys : ι → P.SpendKey) (i : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent P ι), List.map (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.realTable keys) (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.queries (P.derivePub ∘ keys) i) = (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Intent.resolve keys i).spends
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.rejected_eq_not_legal :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (sup : P.Token → Prop) (keys : ι → P.SpendKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι) (b : Bool), LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.rejected sup keys c b = decide ¬LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Legal sup keys c
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.rejection_transport :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] (sup : P.Token → Prop) (adv : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary P ι), (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.experiment sup adv).boolDistAdvantage (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.unguarded adv) ≤ LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.rejectionProbability sup adv / 2
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.run_nullifiers :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {sup : P.Token → Prop} {txs : List (LeanShieldedPool.Tx P)} {st : LeanShieldedPool.St P}, LeanShieldedPool.Run sup txs st → ∀ (nf : P.Nullifier), nf ∈ List.flatMap LeanShieldedPool.Tx.spends txs ↔ nf ∈ st.nullifiers
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.unguarded_eq_test :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} [inst : SampleableType (ι → P.SpendKey)] (adv : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Adversary P ι), 𝒮[LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.unguarded adv] = 𝒮[do let keys ← $ᵗ (ι → P.SpendKey) LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.test adv (P.derivePub ∘ keys) (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.realTable keys)]
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.uniform_update_cont :: ∀ {D R α : Type} [Finite D] [inst : DecidableEq D] [Finite R] [Nonempty R] [inst_3 : SampleableType R] [inst_4 : SampleableType (D → R)] (x : D) (k : (D → R) → ProbComp α), 𝒮[do let f ← $ᵗ (D → R) k f] = 𝒮[do let u ← $ᵗ R let f ← $ᵗ (D → R) k (Function.update f x u)]
LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.view_real :: ∀ {P : LeanShieldedPool.PrimSpec} {ι : Type} (keys : ι → P.SpendKey) (c : LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Challenge P ι) (b : Bool), LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.view (P.derivePub ∘ keys) (LeanShieldedPool.WithdrawGame.Transport.realTable keys) c b = LeanShieldedPool.GameCorrespondence.observerView (c.history keys b)
